company.name: AliveCor
company.shortDescription: AliveCor is a FDA-cleared mobile heart solution that helps save lives, save money, and brings healthcare into the 21st century.
company.description:
AliveCor has a device and application that will turn any smartphone into a clinical-quality electrocardiogram (ECG) recorder. AliveCor is pioneering the creation of FDA-cleared 'machine learning' techniques to enable proactive heart care and is recognized around the world for transforming cardiac care. It specializes in the fields of healthcare, mobile device, and medicine.

It was founded in 2010 and headquartered in Mountain View, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: AliveCor is researching and developing mobile and handheld devices and systems for cardiac monitoring, including methods for determining optimal auscultation locations, blood pressure monitoring using mobile devices, and digital stethoscopes. Their work includes ECG sensors in packaging, machine learning health analysis, multi-parameter monitoring, mobile QT analysis, and systems for ECG signal detection and interpretation. These areas focus on mobile cardiac health solutions and physiological monitoring.

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: AliveCor combines Clinical Trial ECG Solutions with AliveCor AI.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,607,033 to $1,215,786,098, a 126.55x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
